label: Symbol field (math-symbol motif)
description: The math-symbol motif of a hand-made brand film (the Quotient rebrand's symbol field): + - x / = and the plus-minus filling a shape, in one ink, centred on (x, y). `shape` is a preset (home-left: a trail down the left sweeping right; home-right: an arc trailing down; cluster: a loose corner cluster; frame-top-right, frame-bottom-left: the mockup frame's corners) or your own ASCII art (`#` always a symbol, `:` one about half the time, anything else empty; rows separated by newlines). reveal 'all' (default) lands it whole at `at`; 'handfuls' builds it in `handfuls` random handfuls `step` seconds apart (a crescendo). Once it is there, a few symbols flip into their partners every flip_every seconds (+ into x, - into /, = into the plus-minus). cell is the px size of one symbol. A pure function of the time. Example: {"shape":"home-left","color":"#FFEFDE","x":0.16,"y":0.55,"cell":30,"reveal":"handfuls","at":0.3}.

shape.label: Preset (home-left | home-right | cluster | frame-top-right | frame-bottom-left) or ASCII art

seed.label: Picks the symbols (same seed, same field)

x.label: Centre x, fraction of the box

y.label: Centre y, fraction of the box

flips.label: Symbols flip into their partners on a cadence
